name: dating
description: Dating monorepo — run API + UI together from the repo root

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,ui -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.dev:ready: concurrently -k -n api,ui -c blue,green "npm run dev:api:ready" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.dev:ui: node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev:webpack --prefix dating-ui
